population.value: participants in studies of neurological diseases

primary_findings.quote: Higher MD adherence was associated with reduced risk or prevalence of Alzheimer's disease (odds ratios = 0.92), mild cognitive impairment (RR = 0.93), depression (RR = 0.96), and Parkinson's disease (RR = 0.90), with moderate certainty of evidence.
